label: OM4501 40G-SR4 BiDi passive multimode fibre TAP (1 tap, 50/50, MTP)
description: Passive 40G tap for OM4 multimode: two MTP/MPO network ports carry the bidirectional 40GBASE-SR4 link through unpowered and two MTP/MPO monitor ports deliver the 50/50 copies. Pure optical split, no power and no management interface.
